behavior.assetReconciliation: POST /workspaces/:organizationId/operations/reconcile-assets identifies and prunes unattached/archived assets, supporting ?dryRun=true preview and enforcing legal hold lock (HTTP 423 Locked)
behavior.workspaceSafeErasure: POST /workspaces/:organizationId/operations/erasure enforces OWNER-only role authorization, exact confirmText confirmation, in-flight job guards, legal hold lock (HTTP 423), child data purge, BrandBrain scrambling, and tenant anonymization while strictly preserving immutable financial ledgers (CreditEntry, CreditReservation, BillingInvoice)
behavior.tests: 20 unit tests in tests/data-governance.test.ts passing locally with 0 failures; integration tests in tests/integration/data-export.test.ts covering dry-run reconciliation, role enforcement, legal hold lock, and safe erasure

limits: Workspace record erasure and asset pruning only; does not bypass database foreign key constraints
Financial credit entries and billing invoices remain immutable by design
Windows environment limits: full Compose verification runs on Linux CI
